title: Sodium
description: A modern rendering engine for Minecraft which greatly improves performance
body:
# Sodium

Sodium is a **free and open-source** rendering engine for *Minecraft* with `advanced` internals.

## Features

- Greatly improved frame rates
- [Our wiki](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/wiki) has more
- ![A screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/screenshot.png) inline pictures become their words

```
java -jar example.jar
```

<center>HTML is stripped, its words kept</center>

|--------|-------|
| cell   | text  |
